summary: MinSU Clearance System — iteration 2 regression + new validation coverage. Backend: 45/45 pytest tests pass (was 32/32; added 12 validation-focused tests). All server-side Pydantic validation returns HTTP 422 with a clean single-string `detail` (RequestValidationError handler correctly flattens the first error). Every happy path from iteration 1 still works: register (student + faculty), login, create clearance with AY 2025-2026, full 5+Registrar approval chain (approve now requires signature_data PNG data URL), rejection with comments, admin list-users / audit-logs / delete-user, non-admin gating, registrar-last rule, self-delete + last-admin safeguards. Frontend: login inline errors under .field-error + .input-error confirmed for invalid email/blank password; register inline errors confirmed for bad name/email/short password; password-strength meter present and reaches level=4 on strong passwords (width 100%); admin login lands on dashboard; student happy path (register→create clearance→dashboard) works; duplicate-clearance detection shows warning toast 'You already have a pending clearance for this semester' and no duplicate row is created.

minor.issue: Signature-required validation runs BEFORE the Registrar-last-approval gate. If a registrar sends action=approve without signature_data while other offices are still pending, the response is 422 (missing signature) instead of the more helpful 400 'Registrar can only approve after all other offices'. Not a bug (validation-first is correct), but the audit trail loses the domain-specific reason on that particular misuse.
Still accepts unknown user_id and returns success (carried over from iteration 1).
allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is still present (iteration 1 comment).

ui_bugs.issue: Both Semester and Academic Year are HTML <select> elements with the `required` attribute, so submitting empty triggers the browser's native validity bubble ('Please select an item in the list') INSTEAD of the custom inline .field-error + .input-error red styling that the spec asks for. Custom Validate.required / Validate.academicYear inside submitClearanceForm never runs because native form validation intercepts submit first. Additionally, because AY is a select (not a free-text input), it is impossible to type an invalid format like '2025' or '2025-2027' from the UI — the frontend academic-year validator is therefore unreachable via the modal.

issues: (Carried from iteration 1) Status pill still renders 'APPROVED'/'REJECTED' for success/failure audit statuses — semantically misleading.

action_items: (Optional) In createClearance modal, remove the `required` attribute from the two <select>s OR add `novalidate` on the form so the custom Validate.required / setFieldError flow can render the .field-error UI as intended. Currently native browser bubbles win.

(Optional) If the intent was to validate free-form academic-year strings like '2025-2027', the AY field must become an <input> (or a <select> with only well-formed AY options — which is the current state). If it stays a select, remove Validate.academicYear from the frontend or clarify it is defensive-only.
(Optional carryover) Restrict CORS allow_origins to explicit host when allow_credentials=True.
(Optional carryover) Return 404 from /api/auth/logout when user_id doesn't exist.
(Optional carryover) Rename Audit Trail status pills APPROVED/REJECTED → SUCCESS/FAILURE.
critical_code_review_comments: Server-side password/name/role/office/semester/AY/signature/comments validation is centrally enforced in Pydantic models with a global RequestValidationError handler that flattens the pydantic error array into a single-string `detail`. Clean pattern, well tested (see TestRegisterValidation and TestClearanceValidation).
admin_delete_user already covers: self-delete (400), last-admin (400), student-with-pending (400), faculty-with-office-pending (400). Solid.
signature_data size cap 2 MB is enforced only after data URL prefix check; consider also validating base64 payload before hashing/storing in Mongo.
Frontend Validate object duplicates server validators (email/password/name/AY). Fine for UX, but keep them in sync — client already relaxes password validation on Sign In (strict=false).
Trust model unchanged: user_id is still a query parameter (no session/JWT). Fine for MVP but must be replaced before production.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (rewritten: 45 tests, added TestRegisterValidation + TestClearanceValidation + admin self-delete/last-admin tests, signature_data added to all approve calls)

success_rate.frontend: 6/7 flows fully verified — see UI bug on Create Clearance modal inline errors

seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates ~10 users (student, 6 faculty, reject-student+faculty, delete-target) and 3 clearances under a per-run RUN_ID prefix. Idempotent across iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Pydantic validation returns 422 with a single-string `detail` (RequestValidationError handler flattens). Approve calls now require signature_data as a valid data:image/... URL — any prior test using {action:'approve'} without a signature must be updated to include SIG_PNG. Reject calls require non-empty comments. The Create Clearance modal in the frontend uses <select> for both fields with `required`, so the browser's native validity bubble suppresses the custom .field-error UI on empty submit — that is the one confirmed UI gap.
rca of the issue: Create Clearance modal inline-error gap: the fields have HTML5 `required` attribute, so `form.submit` triggers the browser's built-in constraint validation before the JS submit handler runs its Validate.required + setFieldError flow. Fix: add `novalidate` to <form id='createClearanceForm'> OR drop the `required` attribute on those <select>s. Reproduction: student login → click 'Request Clearance' → click 'Submit Request' with both selects untouched → observe native tooltip instead of red inline .field-error.
